title: Lifecycle Growth Experiments Sprint — Experiment Tracker (SSoT)
content:
Last updated: 2025-04-28 (Tyler Benson)
Sprint: Lifecycle Growth Experiments (Activation + Early Retention)
Scope: Self-serve/PLG developers + lapsed signups
Primary activation definition (per PM-412): first_request_success (first 2xx completion) within 72h of signup
Secondary activation milestone: first_streaming_success (if streaming is enabled in quickstart path)
Retention: D7 and D14 active usage (any successful request)
Attribution: UTMs captured on landing + stitched into events (ENG-2844 / PR #8944)

How to use this tracker
- One row per experiment (or tightly-coupled set of variants).
- Use Experiment ID in dashboards + event properties: experiment_id, variant_id, assignment_unit.
- Status meanings: planned (spec only), building (in dev/QA), running (live), paused (stopped early), completed (ended + analyzing), shipped (rolled forward), archived (rolled back).
- Required guardrails must be monitored daily while running.

Columns
experiment_id | channel | surface | owner | start_date | stop_date | status | assignment_unit | audience/targeting_rules | exclusion/suppression_rules | variants (control -> treatments) | primary_metric | secondary_metrics | guardrails | instrumentation_notes | rollout/kill_switch | analysis_owner | notes

EXP-001 | email | lifecycle onboarding | Ben Carter | 2025-04-08 | 2025-04-22 | completed | user_id | New self-serve signups (no sales-assisted flag) in last 0–24h; country != embargoed; verified email | Suppress if unsubscribed OR bounced OR spam-complaint; suppress if account_type=enterprise_trial; suppress if billing_added within first 2h; suppress if support_escalation_open=true | Control: existing 2-email minimal series -> T1: 5-email series v1 (Welcome, Quickstart, First-success, Troubleshooting, Next-step) | Activation rate within 72h (first_request_success) | Time-to-first-success (p50/p75); D7 retention; click-to-activation rate | Unsub rate >0.6% daily; spam complaints >0.08%; support tickets tagged “onboarding-email” +30% WoW; deliverability (inbox rate) | Email send logged with campaign_name + utm_*; join by user_id; ensure first_request_success uses server-side event | Marketo program toggle + suppression list; emergency pause = global campaign pause | Sana Farid | Subject line A/B nested under EXP-001A (see below). Copy aligned w/ messaging pillars doc; avoid benchmark claims unless linking to substantiation.

EXP-001A | email | lifecycle onboarding | Ben Carter | 2025-04-08 | 2025-04-15 | completed | user_id | Same as EXP-001; only recipients eligible for “Welcome” email | Same as EXP-001 | Control: Subject A (“Welcome to Redwood — your first inference call in 5 minutes”) -> T1: Subject B (“Ship LLM inference faster: copy/paste quickstart inside”) | Open-to-click rate on Email #1 | Activation within 72h; time-to-first-success | Same as EXP-001 (plus: hard bounce rate >2%) | Track email_subject_variant in send logs; must not leak into product events | Marketo A/B test; pause if deliverability dips | Tyler Benson | Winner used for remainder of sprint; B had higher CTR but slightly lower open.

EXP-002 | console | onboarding checklist | Marissa Cole | 2025-04-09 | 2025-04-23 | completed | user_id | Logged-in console users who have not fired first_request_success; show on Dashboard + Project setup; only for accounts created <14d | Exclude if already activated OR internal users OR console_role=viewer_only; hide after checklist_complete or activation | Control: no checklist -> T1: checklist v1 (Create API key, Make first request, Enable streaming, View latency/cost dashboard) | Activation within 72h (first_request_success) | Checklist step completion rate; time-to-first-success; D7 retention | Console p95 load time +5% max; error rate +0.2pp max; banner dismissal rage-clicks; support-link clicks spike | Requires event emission: api_key_created, first_request_success, first_streaming_success, dashboard_viewed (ENG-2841 / PR #8932); checklist_impression/click/step_complete (PR #8938) | Feature flag: console_onboarding_checklist_v1 + experiment bucketing (PR #8941); rollback = disable flag | Mei Lin | Early QA found missing property on first_request_success for some SDK paths; hotfix landed 2025-04-11.

EXP-003 | console | contextual banner (API key) | Paula Mendes | 2025-04-09 | 2025-04-23 | completed | user_id | Users who navigate to “API Keys” and do not create a key within 60s OR hit auth error in quickstart | Exclude if api_key_created already true; exclude if >=3 keys already exist; hide after key created | Control: no banner -> T1: banner “Create an API key to make your first request” + deep link to key creation modal | api_key_created within same session | Activation within 72h | Console p95 +5%; support tickets tagged “api-key” +20%; banner click-through abnormally low (<1%) indicates placement issue | Emit banner_impression, banner_click, banner_dismiss + reason codes; ensure deep link route stable | Feature flag: banner_api_key_helper_v1 | Allison Grant | Jira SUP-2862 tied to copy confusion; adjust copy post-sprint if shipped.

EXP-004 | console | contextual banner (Streaming) | Henry Cho | 2025-04-12 | 2025-04-23 | completed | user_id | Activated users (first_request_success) who have not had first_streaming_success within 48h; plus users viewing Chat quickstart docs from console | Exclude if sdk=unknown; suppress if user is embeddings-only project (project_tag=embeddings_only) | Control: no banner -> T1: banner with CTA “Try streaming responses (recommended)” linking to docs + code snippet | first_streaming_success within 7d of signup | D7 retention; tokens per active day | Support tickets tagged “streaming” +25%; error rate on streaming endpoint; console SLO | Requires first_streaming_success event with sdk + model + region props | Feature flag: banner_streaming_try_v1 | Sana Farid | Treatment improved streaming adoption; unclear impact on overall activation (post-activation nudge).

EXP-005 | retargeting | LinkedIn ads | Tyler Benson | 2025-04-10 | 2025-04-24 | completed | user_id (when possible) / cookie_id | Non-activated signups (no first_request_success) 1–14d after signup; US/CA/UK/DE; exclude existing paying customers | Suppress if unsubscribed OR do_not_track=true OR sales_assist=true; frequency cap 2/day | Control: generic dev platform message -> T1: “Copy/paste quickstart + streaming + cost dashboards” creative set | Activation within 7d of ad click (first_request_success) | Landing page CVR; time-to-first-success among clickers | CPC spikes; CTR drop >30% after creative fatigue; privacy/compliance (consent) | Ensure UTMs: utm_source=linkedin&utm_campaign=plg_activation_sprint&utm_content=concept_*; capture in landing + propagate to events (PR #8944) | Pause via LinkedIn campaign manager; audiences in Segment | Mei Lin | Attribution caveat: cookie loss means we report blended lift + last-touch where available.

EXP-006 | retargeting | Google Search | Tyler Benson | 2025-04-10 | 2025-04-24 | completed | click_id / user_id | Branded + high-intent keywords ("Redwood inference", "LLM inference API", "vLLM hosting") targeting lapsed signups and general; geo US/UK/DE | Suppress internal traffic; exclude customers with billing_added; negative keywords for support terms | Control: existing brand campaign -> T1: new ad group emphasizing “low latency + predictable cost + quickstart” | Activation within 7d of click (first_request_success) | CPC; landing page CVR; D7 retention among clickers | Spend cap $250/day; CTR <2% triggers creative refresh; compliance review for claims | UTMs + gclid captured; join to first_request_success via attribution stitching | Pause via Google Ads; revert budgets | Sana Farid | Best-performing copy avoided absolute claims; used “benchmarked” language + linked to docs/blog.

EXP-007 | landing page | quickstart variant | Ben Carter | 2025-04-10 | 2025-04-24 | completed | session_id -> user_id | Traffic from onboarding emails + retargeting; route /quickstart?variant=activation_v1 | Exclude users already activated (if known) to reduce noise; if unknown, record as returning/new | Control: existing docs quickstart -> T1: activation landing (curl + SDK tabs + troubleshooting + “View latency/cost dashboard” CTA) | Click-to-activation rate (first_request_success within 24h of landing) | Bounce rate; time on page; support-link clicks | Docs latency/SLO; broken links/404s; support volume | Track landing_variant, referrer, utm_*; ensure console deep links are stable | Feature flag in docs site + router; rollback to control route | Mei Lin | SUP-2841 reported 404 due to console path change; fix shipped 2025-04-12, add link monitor.

EXP-008 | email | troubleshooting trigger | Dev Patel | 2025-04-11 | 2025-04-22 | paused | user_id | Users with >=2 request errors (4xx/5xx) within first 2h AND no first_request_success | Suppress if unsubscribed; suppress if support ticket already open; suppress if region=unknown | Control: no triggered email -> T1: “Common fixes for auth/model/timeout errors” with links to troubleshooting | Activation within 72h after error | Reduced repeat error rate; support deflection | Unsub spikes; spam complaints; misfire risk (emailing wrong users) | Requires error events with error_type + http_status + sdk; ensure backfill doesn’t trigger retroactively | Marketo trigger toggle; kill switch on rule | Sana Farid | Paused after SUP-2849 showed suppression bug (users opted out but still received); re-run only after suppression fix + privacy review.

EXP-009 | console | guardrail telemetry hooks | Sean Gallagher | 2025-04-09 | 2025-04-23 | completed | n/a | Not an experiment; instrumentation for monitoring while other experiments run | n/a | n/a | n/a | n/a | Guardrails: unsubscribe spike, error banner clicks, support-link clicks, console performance | Implemented in PR #8950; alerts in Datadog + Looker | Feature flag: telemetry_guardrails_v1 | Allison Grant | Treat as prerequisite for shipping console nudges.

EXP-010 | console | experiment holdout (global) | Jada Williams | 2025-04-09 | 2025-04-23 | completed | user_id | 10% holdout for all console nudge surfaces (no checklist/banners) to measure incremental lift | Exclude internal users; keep sticky assignment across sessions | Control: holdout -> Treatment: eligible for any console nudges | Activation within 72h | Time-to-first-success; D7 retention | Same console SLO guardrails; watch holdout contamination rate | Requires sticky bucketing middleware (PR #8941); emit experiment_assignment events | Kill switch: disable middleware; default to holdout=0% | Sana Farid | Holdout used for combined console nudge impact; document overlap with email experiments in analysis.

Decision log (quick)
- 2025-04-07: Activation metric locked to first_request_success within 72h (PM-412). Streaming remains secondary.
- 2025-04-11: Console event hotfix for missing property discovered post-launch (ENG thread); annotate analysis window pre/post fix.
- 2025-04-15: Email subject line variant selected (EXP-001A) and applied to remainder of series.
- 2025-04-17: Troubleshooting trigger email paused due to suppression/compliance issue (SUP-2849).

Open questions / TODOs
- Confirm final reporting cut: include only users with complete 14d window by readout date.
- Decide whether EXP-003 banner copy change constitutes new experiment ID or iteration under same ID.
- Add per-SDK slices to dashboards (TS/Python/curl) once instrumentation coverage confirmed (ENG-2845).

Data joins (notes to self)
- Primary join keys: user_id; fallback anonymous identifiers: session_id/cookie_id (landing) + click_id (ads).
- Event props required in analysis: experiment_id, variant_id, signup_ts, sdk, region, model, http_status (errors), utm_source/utm_campaign/utm_content.
- Exclude Redwood internal traffic (email domain + internal_user flag).
